title: Channel · {{name}}
subtitle: How work from a client reaches this {{kind}}, and what they can see of it.
inherited: Inherited from <1>{{from}}</1>. Picking a client here overrides it for this list only.
listVisible: Work created here will be visible to them unless marked internal. Where their reports <1>arrive</1> is set below.
spaceInherits: Every list under this space inherits the client, so work created in any of them is visible to them by default.
nothingDelivers: Nothing delivers here — no integration is pointed at this list.
deliversNowhere: delivers nowhere — anything it sends is being lost.
noInboxYet: An integration with no inbox yet…
fromNowOn: From now on. Reports already filed stay where they are.
nowhereLost: Nowhere — anything {{name}} sends is being lost.
spaceIsNotInbox: A space isn't an inbox: open the list you want and point it there.
noChannelYet: No channel yet. Opening one gives you a key a client's app or widget posts reports with.
listReachesNone: This list reaches no channel. Bind it to one above, or open a channel on the space it belongs to — a list inherits, it doesn't own.
slugFixed: Reports are named <1>{{example}}</1>, so the slug can't change.
widgetKeyPublic: This key ships inside the browser widget, so treat it as public. It can only file reports — it can't read or triage them, by design.
webhookHelp: Where their app hears about new reports and replies. Clearing this stops those events — and nothing on their side can tell that they stopped.
webhookSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current one
rotateWarning: Anything still using the old key stops working the moment you confirm — their widget, their server, whatever posts reports. Nothing warns them.
okPointed: Its reports will arrive here from now on
okMoved: Their reports will arrive here from now on
